summary:
Comprehensive architectural implementation plan covering:
1. App Drawer UI overhaul matching uploaded screenshot (header, search bar, semi-transparent backdrop).
2. Squarish bubble folder styling on home screen (translucent squircle with subtle bubble outline).
3. Folder popup overhaul (label-free icon grid, topbar with folder title and (+) button for adding app icons only).
4. Unified home screen widget long-press handling (simultaneous resize frame display and multi-cell drag & drop movement).
